title: Every exchange crystallizes · said, counted, crystallized, added

reference.grammar: Four panels on black: a message and its answer as dots, the counts split into two strands, a crystal, and the steps they add to the helix.

techniques.name: Helix step

dotp.label: Dot pitch
dotp.note: Spacing of the counted dots: held inside each panel.

dots.label: Dot size
dots.note: Size of each counted dot (one to a character), against the page’s: held where neighbors never touch.

form.label: Crystal
form.note: Which of the page’s three crystal forms the exchange sets into: one for each model (I, II, III).

crystal.label: Crystal size
crystal.note: Size of each crystal the record sets into: held clear of the labels.

yaw.label: Yaw
yaw.note: Turns every block about its own vertical axis; past ±0.3 neighbors interpenetrate.

pitch.label: Viewing angle
pitch.note: How steeply the blocks are seen from above, against the page’s own view.

techniques.implementation: Every character of a record is one dot; position comes from the model, tone from who wrote it. Drawn by the source page’s own code, with its stair, block, sun and crystal helpers given dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: flight · one block to an exchange, on the helix
